topics.title: Who lives in Slovakia or abroad

claims.text: U1 asks if anyone lives in Bratislava, Slovakia, or has moved abroad
U2 mentions two acquaintances abroad: @AndriiRaccoon in Austria and walternet134 in Poland
U3 says they have at least two acquaintances in Austria
U3 notes one acquaintance recently arrived and another has been there for several years
U1 states they have been in Slovakia for almost a year and do not know the language
U1 asks how to find a job abroad and whether it was difficult
U3 says it was hard but they managed within two months
U3 recommends searching on LinkedIn
U3 reports sending about 100 applications, receiving only 3 interview invitations
U3 says most vacancies require local language proficiency (95%)
U3 notes some cases accept candidates with little language skill
U3 says higher education rarely matters for hiring
U3 says they applied to any job without language requirement and to all tech stacks at first
U1 asks which language is spoken in Austria (German)
U3 replies that communication with them is in English
U3 says most employers ask for B2 level German, sometimes B1, and certificates are not usually required
U3 mentions personal difficulty with language barrier in everyday life and feeling like a migrant if speaking English
U1 asks about approximate salary and whether U3 applied as a junior
U3 believes salaries in Europe are higher than in Ukraine but not many notice
U3 says they accepted a minimal salary despite higher offers because they needed work quickly
U3 mentions needing to find a job by 04.03, influencing salary acceptance
U1 notes that improving language skills could allow better job applications and confidence
